changes.comment: Names build outputs `.mjs` and `.cjs` instead of `.esm.js` and `.cjs.js`, and adds explicit extensions to the relative specifiers of published declaration files.\n\nNode infers a `.js` file's format from the nearest package.json `type` field, so the `require` condition resolved to a file parsed as ESM and threw `ReferenceError: exports is not defined in ES module scope` on a CommonJS consumer's first line. The declarations had the mirror problem: extensionless relative re-exports do not resolve under `moduleResolution: nodenext`, and because nearly every project sets `skipLibCheck: true` the errors were suppressed while every re-exported symbol silently degraded to `any` — a green build with no completions and no type checking, which is worse than a hard failure because nothing about it looks like one.
